  "disclosures": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "from": 4,
      "to": 4,
      "text": "姓名。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "from": 5,
      "to": 5,
      "text": "苏天晴。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "from": 6,
      "to": 6,
      "text": "昏暗的房间里传出清脆悦耳的女声，还有一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "from": 7,
      "to": 7,
      "text": "苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "from": 8,
      "to": 11,
      "text": "镜中显现出灿烂金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵、精致五官和炸毛大尾巴的娇小金毛狐女。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "from": 12,
      "to": 12,
      "text": "嗯嗯……这样啊……",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "from": 13,
      "to": 13,
      "text": "房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回黑色古书。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "from": 15,
      "to": 15,
      "text": "五分钟前，苏天晴结束连续三个夜班后坐在街边面摊吃加煎蛋的牛肉面，听到太奶在背后说话，回头见太奶坐藤椅编围巾，随后胸口一疼眼前一黑。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GreatGrandma"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D9",
      "from": 16,
      "to": 17,
      "text": "苏天晴伸手薅了狐狐的大尾巴，感到柔顺触感和从尾巴尖直冲天灵盖的陌生摩挲拉拽感，惊得耳朵竖起、整只狐绷直。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D10",
      "from": 18,
      "to": 18,
      "text": "好真实的触感！",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D11",
      "from": 19,
      "to": 19,
      "text": "……你干嘛呢。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D12",
      "from": 20,
      "to": 20,
      "text": "黑色古书不太明白眼前的狐狐为什么突然用怪异手法薅自己的尾巴。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D13",
      "from": 21,
      "to": 21,
      "text": "不疼的吗？",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D14",
      "from": 22,
      "to": 22,
      "text": "咳咳！等一下，稍等一下！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "request",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D15",
      "from": 23,
      "to": 23,
      "text": "苏天晴干咳掩饰尴尬，阻止古书继续说话，并飞快理清思绪。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D16",
      "from": 24,
      "to": 24,
      "text": "我重生了。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D17",
      "from": 25,
      "to": 25,
      "text": "重生成了一只金毛狐女。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D18",
      "from": 26,
      "to": 26,
      "text": "那么眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能给我解释一下吗？",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D19",
      "from": 27,
      "to": 27,
      "text": "你是谁？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D20",
      "from": 28,
      "to": 28,
      "text": "古书沉默思考眼前呆头呆脑的狐狐是否是自己要找的人，随后重复两分钟前的开场白。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D21",
      "from": 29,
      "to": 29,
      "text": "吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D22",
      "from": 30,
      "to": 30,
      "text": "而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D23",
      "from": 31,
      "to": 31,
      "text": "再次听完这中二到能让人用脚趾扣出三室一厅的台词，苏天晴又陷入了沉默与思索。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D24",
      "from": 32,
      "to": 33,
      "text": "狐狐从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默看向镜中穿宽松睡裙的娇小身影，并抬脚欣赏白皙软嫩带红晕的小脚。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D25",
      "from": 34,
      "to": 34,
      "text": "嗯，完美，绝品。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D26",
      "from": 35,
      "to": 35,
      "text": "看来你对现在的身体很满意嘛。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D27",
      "from": 36,
      "to": 36,
      "text": "古书瞅见狐狐认真欣赏脚丫，一时语塞，憋了半天才冒出话。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D28",
      "from": 37,
      "to": 37,
      "text": "但是你为什么要盯着脚看？正常情况下不应该是……",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D29",
      "from": 38,
      "to": 38,
      "text": "你不懂，小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭的时候看见了都能多炫两碗。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D30",
      "from": 39,
      "to": 40,
      "text": "苏天晴嘴上回答古书，心里对现状有大概了解；她推测这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "conjecture",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury", "R_OriginalOwner", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D31",
      "from": 41,
      "to": 41,
      "text": "既然你这么满意，那咱们可以直接快进到下个步骤了。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "plan",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox", "R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D32",
      "from": 43,
      "to": 43,
      "text": "听着，苏天晴。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "request",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D33",
      "from": 44,
      "to": 44,
      "text": "你是墨丘利秘典的最佳适格者，作为星界使者，我会引导你走上完美的生活，而你只需要与我签订一个小小的契约——",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "promise",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury", "R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D34",
      "from": 45,
      "to": 45,
      "text": "好，我签。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "promise",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D35",
      "from": 48,
      "to": 48,
      "text": "不是，你不按套路出牌啊，契约怎么说签就签的？都不犹豫考虑一下吗？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D36",
      "from": 49,
      "to": 49,
      "text": "这就是你思想狭隘了，小破书。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D37",
      "from": 50,
      "to": 50,
      "text": "我问你，世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D38",
      "from": 51,
      "to": 51,
      "text": "……哪两个？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D39",
      "from": 53,
      "to": 53,
      "text": "取之不尽的财富！以及变成萝莉！这是世界上最通用的两个愿望！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D40",
      "from": 55,
      "to": 55,
      "text": "变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D41",
      "from": 58,
      "to": 58,
      "text": "既然你答应，那我们之间的契约就算成立了？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_Contract", "R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D42",
      "from": 59,
      "to": 59,
      "text": "成立。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D43",
      "from": 61,
      "to": 61,
      "text": "那个……我能问问契约的具体内容吗？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D44",
      "from": 62,
      "to": 62,
      "text": "总不能是激活了什么奇怪的奴隶契约吧！那样的话可就亏大发了！",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "conjecture",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Contract", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D45",
      "from": 63,
      "to": 63,
      "text": "反派魔法少女。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_VillainMagicGirl", "R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D46",
      "from": 66,
      "to": 66,
      "text": "既然契约已经签订，那么从今天开始，你就将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主给你量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助你逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_Contract", "R_SuTianqing", "R_MagicGirl", "R_Creator", "R_VillainMagicGirl"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D47",
      "from": 67,
      "to": 67,
      "text": "不是、等一下！魔法少女是怎么回事！是那种死亡率高达90%的高危职业吗？！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_MagicGirl"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D48",
      "from": 68,
      "to": 68,
      "text": "放心吧，是王道系的那种。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_MagicGirl"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D49",
      "from": 69,
      "to": 69,
      "text": "就是这样才不对吧！在王道故事里当反派不是纯纯的找死吗！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_VillainMagicGirl", "R_MagicGirl"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D50",
      "from": 70,
      "to": 70,
      "text": "苏天晴突然有点后悔了。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Contract"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D51",
      "from": 71,
      "to": 71,

  "disclosures": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "from": 4,

      "text": "姓名。",

    {
      "id": "D2",

      "to": 5,
      "text": "苏天晴。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "from": 6,
      "to": 6,
      "text": "昏暗的房间里传出清脆悦耳的女声，还有一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "from": 7,
      "to": 7,
      "text": "苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "from": 8,
      "to": 11,
      "text": "镜中显现出灿烂金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵、精致五官和炸毛大尾巴的娇小金毛狐女。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "from": 12,
      "to": 12,
      "text": "嗯嗯……这样啊……",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "from": 13,
      "to": 13,
      "text": "房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回黑色古书。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "from": 15,
      "to": 15,
      "text": "五分钟前，苏天晴结束连续三个夜班后坐在街边面摊吃加煎蛋的牛肉面，听到太奶在背后说话，回头见太奶坐藤椅编围巾，随后胸口一疼眼前一黑。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GreatGrandma"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D9",
      "from": 16,
      "to": 17,
      "text": "苏天晴伸手薅了狐狐的大尾巴，感到柔顺触感和从尾巴尖直冲天灵盖的陌生摩挲拉拽感，惊得耳朵竖起、整只狐绷直。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D10",
      "from": 18,
      "to": 18,
      "text": "好真实的触感！",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D11",
      "from": 19,
      "to": 19,
      "text": "……你干嘛呢。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D12",
      "from": 20,
      "to": 20,
      "text": "黑色古书不太明白眼前的狐狐为什么突然用怪异手法薅自己的尾巴。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D13",
      "from": 21,
      "to": 21,
      "text": "不疼的吗？",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D14",
      "from": 22,
      "to": 22,
      "text": "咳咳！等一下，稍等一下！",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "request",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D15",
      "from": 23,
      "to": 23,
      "text": "苏天晴干咳掩饰尴尬，阻止古书继续说话，并飞快理清思绪。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D16",
      "from": 24,
      "to": 24,
      "text": "我重生了。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D17",
      "from": 25,
      "to": 25,
      "text": "重生成了一只金毛狐女。",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_GoldenFox"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D18",
      "from": 26,
      "to": 26,
      "text": "那么眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能给我解释一下吗？",
      "channel": "thought",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D19",
      "from": 27,
      "to": 27,
      "text": "你是谁？",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "question",
      "holder": "R_SuTianqing",
      "about": ["R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D20",
      "from": 28,
      "to": 28,
      "text": "古书沉默思考眼前呆头呆脑的狐狐是否是自己要找的人，随后重复两分钟前的开场白。",
      "channel": "narrator",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": null,
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_GoldenFox", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D21",
      "from": 29,
      "to": 29,
      "text": "吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_Mercury", "R_SuTianqing"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D22",
      "from": 30,
      "to": 30,
      "text": "而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。",
      "channel": "speech",
      "mode": "assertion",
      "holder": "R_Mercury",
      "about": ["R_SuTianqing", "R_Mercury"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D23",
      "from": 31,
      "to": 31,
      "text": "再次听完这中二到能让人用脚趾扣出三室一厅的台词，苏天晴又陷入了沉默与思索。",
